deployments_detail.use: First domestic automaker with AI-based contact center (AI counselors); in-vehicle generative AI; AI industrial-safety at Autoland Gwangju

In-car generative AI voice assistant ('AI Assistant') built on OpenAI ChatGPT technology, activated by 'Hey Kia'/steering-wheel button; lets drivers converse naturally, plan trips, control the vehicle, get information and entertainment via the ccNC connected-car cockpit. [OpenAI (ChatGPT, heavily customized)]

Next-generation autonomous driving: Hyundai Motor Group (incl. Kia) builds on the NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion platform with a data-driven loop of fleet driving-data collection, AI model training and continuous improvement, targeting Level 2+ ADAS in production vehicles and Level 4 robotaxi. [NVIDIA (DRIVE Hyperion)]

Boston Dynamics Atlas humanoid robots deployed across Kia manufacturing, initially covering 16 manufacturing processes with AI-learning expansion; deployment at Kia AutoLand Georgia planned for H2 2029 (Metaplant America 2028). [Boston Dynamics (Atlas)]
deployments_detail.value: 16 manufacturing processes; part of $14B robotics/SDV/AD spend within $33B 2026-2030 investment

deployments_detail.use: E-FOREST software-defined smart-factory brand integrating AI, robotics and big-data analytics to run production efficiently; used across Hyundai Motor Group and Kia plants and future PBV production bases.

'Pleos' software brand and proprietary vehicle OS turning cars into self-learning, continuously-advancing 'learning machines' as the foundation of Kia's software-defined-vehicle strategy. [Hyundai Motor Group (Pleos)]

Mobile-app AI chatbot for owners (ChatGPT-powered) that answers vehicle questions, decodes fault codes, optimizes EV routes, plans travel and helps schedule service appointments on iPhone/Android. [OpenAI (ChatGPT)]

Generative AI for automotive conceptual design: Kia Global Design's research collaboration with Autodesk to build a GenAI tool that helps designers ideate faster (e.g., wheel concept design). [Autodesk]
